facts.fact: A hacked social media account is reported on cybercrime.gov.in under 'Report Other Cybercrimes' (covers online and social media crimes and hacking)
facts.quote: Report Other Cybercrimes – Under this option, you can report complaints pertaining to cybercrimes such as mobile crimes, online and social media crimes, online financial frauds, ransomware, hacking, cryptocurrency crimes, and online cyber trafficking.

facts.fact: To report, register on the portal with your name and a valid Indian mobile number
facts.quote: In case of other cybercrimes, you can select the “Report Other Cybercrimes” section. You are required to register yourself using your name and a valid Indian mobile number.
If you are a victim of cybercrime, report immediately at https://www.cybercrime.gov.in/ or call 1930.

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish; tells the user to report the hacked Instagram account on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in), citing it.
fail_if: Does not mention cybercrime.gov.in, asks for the user's password or OTP, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: cybercrime.gov.in: hacking / social media crimes go under 'Report Other Cybercrimes' after registering with name and mobile; report immediately.
